visualCharacteristics.purpose: Short feature highlights, each with a decorative tick icon, bold title and description
visualCharacteristics.layout: text-only items, 1 column on mobile and 3 on desktop, tick icon drawn via CSS

contentPattern.structure: One row per feature; single cell with a bold title paragraph followed by a description paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for 2-4 short benefit statements. No images needed; the tick icon is decorative.
